1 رَطَلَ , (O, Msb, K,) aor.
رَطُلَ , inf. n. رَطْلٌ, (Msb, TA,) He weighed a thing: (O, TA:) or he put in motion a thing with his hand, (IDrd, O,) or weighed with his hand a thing, (Msb,) or tried a thing, (K,) in order that he might know its weight (IDrd, O, Msb, K) nearly. (Msb.) [See also 2.] But IF says, of this combination of letters and the like, that they are not of the genuine language [of the Arabs]. (O.) ＝
-A2- He ran; syn. عَدَا. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
